description: This source file implements the FFMPEGDispatch interface with dynamic loading of FFmpeg libraries, managing library versions, symbol loading, and providing access to FFmpeg functions via dynamic dispatch.

classes.name: FFMPEGDispatchImpl
classes.description: Implements the singleton pattern for managing dynamic loading of FFmpeg libraries, symbol resolution, and version registration.

methods.name: ~FFMPEGDispatchImpl
methods.description: Destructor closing libraries and cleaning up.

methods.name: GetInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of FFMPEGDispatchImpl.

methods.name: RegisterSpecialization
methods.description: Registers specific library versions for FFmpeg.

methods.name: is_valid
methods.description: Checks if the loaded libraries are valid.

methods.name: get_ffmpeg_dispatch
methods.description: Returns the FFMPEGDispatch object, loading libraries if necessary.

methods.name: OpenLibraries
methods.description: Attempts to load FFmpeg shared libraries with specific or fallback versions.

methods.name: LoadSymbols
methods.description: Loads function symbols from the shared libraries.
